1589.de: An illusory double figure of a naked young bearded man (self-portrait), in profile. In a kneeling position on a light-coloured pedestal, with bent arms, the upper body and head bowed forward onto the pedestal. The head turned towards the viewer, eyes closed. From the raised buttocks grows a second head, in profile, facing right. An illusion of a figure with a raised upper body, with feet resting on toes instead of bent arms. A uniform lilac-grey background, shadows falling onto the light-coloured pedestal. The figure is modelled in brownish, ochre tones. A metaphysical atmosphere.

1600.d: Alasti mees on valge riideribaga seotud tokki otsa, mis asetseb keset mudast põldu. Mehel jalas vaid vanad nahksed jalatsid. Riideriba, mis on seotud mehe suguelundite ümber, tirib neid mehe liikumisel tahapoole, nii et eestpoolt pole neid enam näha. Aeglaselt ja valuliselt komberdab mees ringiratast, ulatudes nii kaugele, kui riideriba võimaldab. Helitaustaks on puukiige vms. kääksumine. Taevas pilvine ja madal.
1600.de: A naked man is tied by a white strip of cloth to a stick standing in the middle of a muddy field. The man wears only old leather footwear. The strip of cloth, tied around the man's genitals, pulls them backward as the man moves, so that they are no longer visible from the front. The man slowly and painfully hobbles round and round, reaching as far as the strip of cloth allows. The sound background is the creaking of a wooden swing or the like. The sky is cloudy and low.

1744.d: Pihtimuslik dialoog ema ja poja vahel, kus viimane justkui iseennast sundides üritab midagi väga olulist emale ära öelda. Mustvalges, dokumentaalsust rõhutava kareda ülesvõttega video põhiosas – esitatud piklikus kinoformaadis, mis lähtematerjalile omakorda  võõritusefekti lisab – domineerib poja dramaatiline eneseavamisponnistus ja ema ning ka vaataja venitatud ootus, et see miski, lõpuks ära öeldud saaks. Seda raamib argisem, värviline ja tavaformaadis lõik kaamera, valguse ja "esinejate" ülessättimisest.
1744.de: A confessional dialogue between mother and son, in which the latter, as if forcing himself, tries to say something very important to his mother. In the main part of the video, shot in black and white with a rough, documentary-emphasizing style – presented in an elongated cinematic format, which in turn adds an alienation effect to the source material – the son's dramatic effort at self-disclosure dominates, along with the prolonged expectation of the mother, and also the viewer, that this something will finally be said. This is framed by a more everyday, colour, standard-format segment showing the setting up of the camera, lighting and "performers".

1754.d: Fotofilm remiksib arhiivfotosid Kreenholmi Manufaktuurist kuuldemänguga Elfriede Jelineki näidendist „Mis juhtus pärast seda, kui Nora oma mehe maha oli jätnud ehk Ühiskondade toed“. 1950.-1960. aastatest pärit propagandistlikud mustvalged fotod tekstiilitööstuses töötavatest naistest on asetatud näidendi 15. stseeni konteksti, milles Nora on tulnud vabrikusse, et hoiatada naistöölisi ettevõtte peatse sulgemise eest ja kutsuda neid üles emantsipatsioonile. Teos kuulus 2012. aasta Manifesta kunstibiennaali näitusekomplekti, mille eest Marge Monkole eraldati rahvusvaheliselt mainekas Kesk-Ida-Euroopa kaasaegse kunsti toetamiseks asutatud Henkeli kunstipreemia.
1754.de: The photo-film remixes archival photographs from the Kreenholm Manufaktuur with a radio play based on Elfriede Jelinek's play "What Happened After Nora Left Her Husband or Pillars of Society". Black-and-white propagandistic photographs from the 1950s–1960s of women working in the textile industry are placed in the context of the play's 15th scene, in which Nora has come to the factory to warn the female workers of the company's impending closure and to call on them to embrace emancipation. The work was part of the exhibition package of the 2012 Manifesta art biennial, for which Marge Monko was awarded the internationally prestigious Henkel Art Award, established to support contemporary art in Central-Eastern Europe.

1760.d: Fotoinstallatsioon kõrgel neljarattalisel heledast puidust konstruktsioonil. Fotol rohekas-kollakate seinte ja trellitatud aknaga tööruum, milles auruvedurit meenutav erinevatest esemetest koosnev kuhi üksteise otsa asetatud plastikpaakidest ja kokkuvolditud pappkarpidest. Kuhja esiküljele kinnitatud Eesti kaart, küljele toetatud ümar isteplaat ja ratas ning otsas keemialabori läbipaistvatest klaasanumatest ehitatud relva meenutav ese ning kõige tipus pesukaussi hoidev harjavars.
1760.de: A photo installation on a tall four-wheeled structure made of light-coloured wood. The photo shows a workroom with greenish-yellowish walls and a barred window, in which a pile resembling a steam locomotive is composed of various objects, plastic tanks stacked on top of each other, and folded cardboard boxes. On the front of the pile a map of Estonia is attached, a round seat plate and a wheel are leaned against the side, and at the end an object resembling a weapon built from transparent glass vessels from a chemistry lab, and at the very top a broom handle holding a wash basin.

1761.de: A photo installation on a tall five-legged light wood construction. 1762.d: Fotoinstallatsioon madalal kolmerattalisel kahe toega heledast puidust konstruktsioonil. Osades klaasides valged või pruunid munad, plaaditud vaheseina serval kummuli asetatud klaasid, mille sees samuti munad.
1762.de: A photo installation on a low, light-coloured wooden construction with three wheels and two supports. In the photograph, in greenish tones, a restaurant kitchen, on the floor and work surfaces of which pots are stacked in high piles, alternating with glasses and plates, glasses and bowls, and cups and saucers. In some of the glasses there are white or brown eggs; on the edge of a tiled partition, glasses placed upside down, also containing eggs inside.

5801.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge talvine foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ümbrus ja tribüün kaetud lumega, basseini seintel grafiti ja põhi üleni täidetud tikitud sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
5801.de: A black-and-white winter photograph printed on satin fabric, showing an abandoned outdoor pool area in Kadriorg. The surroundings of the pool and the stand are covered with snow, the pool walls bear graffiti and the bottom is entirely filled with embroidered sparkling tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ["Pools"], the bachelor's thesis defended in graphic art at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

5802.d: Atlasskangale trükitud mustvalge sügisene foto hüljatud välibasseinialast Kadriorus. Basseini ja liumäe vaheline kiviplaatidega ala kaetud sambla, muru ja lehtedega, basseini seintel, tribüünil ja tribüüniga külgneval hooneosal grafiti, väikese basseini põhi üleni kaetud tumedate sätendavate torukujuliste helmestega. Töö kuulub autori 2005. aastal Eesti Kunstiakadeemias graafika erialal kaitstud bakalaureusetöö komplekti "Basseinid".
5802.de: Black-and-white autumnal photograph printed on satin fabric of an abandoned outdoor swimming pool area in Kadriorg. The area with stone slabs between the pool and the water slide is covered with moss, grass and leaves; on the pool walls, the stand and the part of the building adjoining the stand there is graffiti, the bottom of the small pool is entirely covered with dark shimmering tube-shaped beads. The work belongs to the author's set of works "Basseinid" ("Pools"), defended as a bachelor's thesis in the printmaking speciality at the Estonian Academy of Arts in 2005.

6019.d: 162-l A4 lehel punase või roosa tähe kujutis - üksik või mitmekordne, prinditud kas lehe ühele või mõlemale poole. Vastavalt printeri värvikasseti tühjaks saamisele muutub tähe kujutis heledamaks, ebaüthlaseks. Lõpuks jääb alles peenikestest triipudest koosnev kujutis.
6019.de: On 162 A4 sheets, a depiction of a red or pink star - single or multiple, printed on one or both sides of the sheet. As the printer's ink cartridge runs empty, the image of the star becomes lighter, uneven. In the end, only an image consisting of thin stripes remains.

6141.dm: kõrgus: 210.0 cm; laius: 100.0 cm; laius: 90.0 cm; laius: 90.0 cm
6141.d: Kolmeosaline, valdavalt intensiivsetes punastes, roosades toonides krobelise faktuuriga kompositsioon. Vasakul osal roosaga piiritletud suur naisenägu, suu, ninajoon, silm mustaga markeeritud. Paremal-keskel maali allosas udupunasel mustaga katkendlikult markeeritud lamava mehe poolfiguur. Väga reljeefne maalipind, mustad kontuurjooned ebaühlaselt sügavates maalikihtides.
6141.de: A three-part composition, predominantly in intense red and pink tones, with a coarse texture. On the left part a large woman's face outlined in pink, mouth, nose line, eye marked in black. On the right-centre, in the lower part of the painting, the half-figure of a lying man marked intermittently in black on a hazy red ground. A very relief-like painted surface, black contour lines in unevenly deep paint layers.

6746.d: Süngetes toonides öine maastik kahe seisva figuuriga. Puudega ääristatud surnuaed, hauakivid rohus, keskel mees ja naine otsevaates, ülakehad paljastatud. Mees kivi peale pissimas, tema kõrval punases seelikus ja peakattes naine sellele sõrmega osutamas, teises käes avatud raamat. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis, mustjad, sünged toonid.
6746.de: A nocturnal landscape in somber tones with two standing figures. A cemetery bordered by trees, gravestones in the grass, in the middle a man and a woman seen frontally, upper bodies bared. The man is urinating onto a stone, beside him a woman in a red skirt and headdress pointing at it with her finger, in her other hand an open book. Expressive manner of depiction, blackish, somber tones.

6747.d: Kaunistustega kõrge seljatoega istmel noor naine otsevaates, pea pööratud vasakule, käed leenil, paljajalu; seljas sinine rüü, hõlmad vaheliti, ümber pea mässitud punane rätt. Mõlemal pool naist suured pruunid koerad: vasak istub, paremapoolne lamab. Üldkoloriit tume, mustjast taustast joonistuvad välja figuurid.
6747.de: Young woman frontally seated on a high-backed decorated seat, head turned to the left, hands on the armrests, barefoot; wearing a blue robe with the flaps crossed, a red scarf wrapped around her head. Large brown dogs on both sides of the woman: the left one sits, the right one lies. Overall colouring dark, the figures stand out against a blackish background.

7001.dm: laius: 480.0 cm (4-osaline x h 6); kõrgus: 244.0 cm
7001.d: Valmiskujundite, aplikatsioonide, valdavalt kofreeritud pleki jm plekitükkidega kaetud ja osaliselt üle värvitud 4-osaline kompositsioon, keskmistel tahvlitel aatomiseene maalitud kujund, mille kohal reljeefsete tähtedega: THE END. Vasakul osal ümarkaareline nišš reljeefse hõbedase naisfiguuriga, viisnurk peaks. Paremal telliseimitatsioonis niššis hõbedane mehe reljeef, viisnurk pea asemel.
7001.de: A 4-part composition covered with ready-made shapes, appliqués, mostly embossed tin and other pieces of tin, and partly overpainted; on the middle panels a painted image of an atomic mushroom cloud, above which in relief letters: THE END. On the left part a rounded arch niche with a relief silver female figure, a pentagram for a head. On the right, in a niche imitating brick, a silver relief of a man, a pentagram instead of a head.

7096.d: Gooti aknaga võlvitud kabelis kuus vanemat meest leinamas, pead paljastatud, käed kõhul. Paremal, nende ees alusele asetatud sark - siniste nuppudega hiiglaslik mobiiltelefon. Maalil tumedad toonid, kohmakas kujutamisviis.
7096.de: In a vaulted chapel with a Gothic window, six older men mourning, heads bared, hands on their stomachs. On the right, in front of them, placed on a stand - a giant mobile phone with blue buttons. Dark tones in the painting, clumsy manner of depiction.

7097.d: Raudtee ääres, vaguni taustal keskmest vasakul naise 3/4 figuur veidi pöördes paremale. Punane seelik ja pearätt, roheline pluus seljas. Vasakus tõstetud käes videokaamera, paremas automaatrelv. Taamal, helesinise taeva taustal kaks ratsanikku ületamas raudteed, esimesel punalipp käes, tagumisel tõstetud mõõk. Tahtlikult kohmakas maalilaad.
7097.de: By the railway, against the background of a railway carriage, left of centre a woman's 3/4 figure slightly turned to the right. Red skirt and headscarf, green blouse. In her raised left hand a video camera, in her right an automatic weapon. In the background, against a light blue sky, two horsemen crossing the railway, the first with a red flag in hand, the one behind with a raised sword. Deliberately clumsy painting style.

7113.d: Maali keskmest vasakul ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga piimjal sinkjashallil taustal, millel mustaga noolemärk kirjaga "valgus" osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine pind ebaühtlaselt must üles suunatud noole ja valge kirjaga "horisont". Ülal- ja allääre keskel neljakandiline templimärk.
7113.de: Left of the centre of the painting, a sphere lit from above with a reddish self-shadow on a milky bluish-grey background, on which in black an arrow marked "valgus" [light] points down to the sphere. The lower surface of the sphere is unevenly black, with an upward-pointing arrow and the white inscription "horisont" [horizon]. In the middle of the top and bottom edges, a rectangular stamp mark.

8007.d: Maali keskmest paremal ülalt valgustatud kera punaka omavarjuga ühtlaselt mustal taustal, millesse sissekraabitud kiri "valgus" ja noolemärk osutamas alla kerale. Kuulist alumine osa laia pintsliga maalitud kirsipunane, heledat läbi kumav pind. Ülaservas väiksem ja allservas suurem valge neljakandiline templimärk.
8007.de: Right of the centre of the painting, a ball lit from above with reddish self-shadow on an evenly black background, into which the word "valgus" (light) and an arrow pointing down at the ball are scratched. The lower part of the ball is painted with a broad brush in cherry red, a bright, translucent surface. In the upper edge a smaller and in the lower edge a larger white square stamp mark.

8078.d: Tervet maali pinda kattev vanaroosat tooni T-tähe geomeetriline kujund kreemvalgel taustal, millest kumab läbi korrapärase sõrestiku jooned.
8078.de: A geometric shape of a T letter in an old-rose tone covering the whole surface of the painting on a creamy white background, through which lines of a regular grid shine.

8086.d: Geomeetrilistest kujunditest minimalistlik kompositsioon: sinkjasvalgel taustal kollakasvalge T-kujund, millel värvi pressitud peened horisontaaltriibud.
8086.de: A minimalist composition of geometric shapes: a yellowish-white T-shape on a bluish-white background, with fine horizontal stripes pressed into the paint.

8087.d: Minimalistlik kompositsioon ristkülikutest: lõheroosal taustal valkjas koloriidis T-kujund, millel neli laia põikitriipu.
8087.de: Minimalist composition of rectangles: on a salmon-pink background a whitish T-shape with four wide transverse stripes.

8088.d: Minimalistlik kompositsioon ristkülikutest: keskmes oranžikas T-kujund kahvatukollasel taustal. Tervet maali katab peenejooneline korrapärane ruudustik.
8088.de: Minimalist composition of rectangles: in the centre an orangish T-shape on a pale yellow background. The entire painting is covered with a fine-lined regular grid.

8230.d: Mäekuplite vahel kääruline sünkhall veekogu, mille vahel sügisvärvides puudega poolsaar. Ekspressiivne kujutamisviis.
8230.de: A winding, dark grey body of water between hill domes, with a peninsula with trees in autumn colours between them. Expressive manner of depiction.

8308.d: Ees künkaline rohumaa, keskel oleva puude ja põõsaste rea vahelt ja üle paistmas hoonete grupid.
8308.de: In front, hilly grassland, in the middle groups of buildings visible through and above a row of trees and bushes.

8341.d: Talvine maastik. Keskel lumiste katustega hooneid, vasemal ja paremal puid, ees lage väli.
8341.de: Winter landscape. In the middle buildings with snowy roofs, trees on the left and right, open field in front.

8631.d: Ees vasemal kraavi perve pidi eest taha kulgev teerada. Vasemal ja paremal kõrgetüvelised männid.
8631.de: In front on the left a path running from front to back along the edge of a ditch. On the left and right tall-trunked pine trees.

8983.d: Linaga kaetud laual istuva naisakti täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Jalgade juures vaas lilledega.
8983.de: Full figure of a female nude sitting on a table covered with linen, in profile to the right. A vase with flowers at her feet.

9288.d: Pruunides, samblastes summutatud sügistoonides põikitriibuline abstraktne kompositsioon. Maalipinnase kinnitatud triipudena hõredalt riiet, paberit, köit jm., mis mitmekihiliselt, kohati voolavate niredena üle maalitud.
9288.de: An abstract composition in brown, mossy, muted autumn tones with cross-striped pattern. Sparsely attached to the painting ground as stripes are fabric, paper, rope etc., which are painted over in multiple layers, in places as flowing rivulets.

10350.d: Tervet maali kattev kohkunud ilmega, veidi punnis- pruunisilmne habeme ja vuntsidega mehe nägu otsevaates. Heleda juuksetüükaga kaetud pea, kortsus otsmik, veidi paokil suu. Kollasetriibuline särgikaelus pisut paistmas. Valge, oranži, pruunikaga maalitud nägu, ooker-kollane taust. Popilik kujutamisviis. Paremal äärel allpool kiri ülalt alla: VANAMEES.
10350.de: The whole painting is covered by the frontal face of a startled-looking, slightly bulging brown-eyed man with a beard and moustache, viewed frontally. Head covered with light hair stubble, wrinkled forehead, mouth slightly ajar. A yellow-striped shirt collar showing slightly. The face painted in white, orange and brownish tones, ochre-yellow background. A pop-like manner of depiction. On the right edge below, an inscription reading from top to bottom: VANAMEES.

10365.d: Eredal punakas-roosakal taustal lamav mustas rõivastuses mees, põlved püsti, pärani suuga pea kuklas, küünarnukkideni paljad käed rüpes.
10365.de: A man dressed in black lying against a bright reddish-pink background, knees raised, mouth wide open with head thrown back, bare arms up to the elbows resting in his lap.

10377.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
10377.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

10411.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm; laius: 30.0 cm; kõrgus: 50.0 cm; laius: 30.0 cm
10411.d: Esimesel osal: Abstraktne kompositsioon alt vasakult tumesinistes toonides, mis lähevad tõustes üle heledamateks lõpetades üleval valkjate toonidega.
10411.de: In the first part: an abstract composition from the lower left in dark blue tones, which turn lighter as they rise, ending at the top in whitish tones.

10417.d: Heledal taustal kaks hallikates hajutatud toonides kõrvuti seisva mehe figuuri otsevaates. Realistlikult on maalitud meeste paljad labajalad.
10417.de: On a light background, two frontal figures of men standing side by side in dispersed greyish tones. The men's bare feet are painted realistically.

10418.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm; laius: 30.0 cm; kõrgus: 50.0 cm; laius: 30.0 cm
10418.d: Esimesel osal: Abstraktne kompositsioon alt vasakult tumepunastes toonides, mis lähevad tõustes üle heledamateks lõpetades üleval kollasega.
10418.de: In the first part: An abstract composition from the lower left in dark red tones, which as they rise turn into lighter ones ending at the top with yellow.

10423.d: Heledal taustal seljaga vaataja poole kandadel kükitava mehe tumedates toonides alastifiguur, pea pööratud poolprofiilis paremale.
10423.de: Against a light background, a dark-toned nude figure of a man crouching on his heels with his back to the viewer, head turned in profile to the right.

10456.d: Maali naturaalne linane taust on kaetud mustjaslillakate kaarjate joonte, punktiiriga, mis teose keskmes muutub tihedamaks joonte, täppide vertikaalseks rägastikuks. Värvaine on kantud lõuendile maali tagaküljelt.(eesti)
10456.de: The natural linen background of the painting is covered with blackish-purple curved lines and dotting, which becomes denser at the centre of the work into a vertical thicket of lines and dots. The paint has been applied to the canvas from the back of the painting.

10496.dm: kõrgus: 125.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 131.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
10496.d: Kollane taust valgete laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega korrapäraselt triipudeks maalitud nii, et ülal 8 võrdset vertikaalset jaotust, allpool põikitriibud. Valgete pindade peale paigutatud korrapäraselt punaste numbrite templijäljed. Maali külgedel kollasega värvitud eenduvate naelte rida.
10496.de: A yellow background painted regularly into stripes with wide white brush-bristle strokes so that above there are 8 equal vertical divisions, below cross stripes. On the white areas, regularly placed stamped impressions of red numbers. On the sides of the painting a row of protruding nails painted yellow.

10497.dm: kõrgus: 125.0 cm; laius: 106.0 cm (koos naeltega); kõrgus: 131.0 cm (koos naeltega); laius: 100.0 cm
10497.d: Roheline taust valgete laiade pintsli-harjatõmmetega kaheksaks vertikaaltriibuks maalitud, keskel kaks põiki jaotust. Valgete pindade peale punaste numbrite templijäljed korrapäraselt paigutatud. Maali külgedel roheliseks värvitud naelte rida.
10497.de: Green background painted with wide white brush-strokes into eight vertical stripes, with two crosswise divisions in the middle. Stamped impressions of red numbers regularly arranged on the white surfaces. A row of nails painted green along the sides of the painting.

10656.d: Tume tööstusmaastik suitsevate korstende ja tootmishoonetega.
10656.de: A dark industrial landscape with smoking chimneys and production buildings.

10657.d: Valgete juuste, habeme ja vuntside ning punase ninaga vana mehe portree, rinnas kolm ordenit.
10657.de: Portrait of an old man with white hair, beard and moustache, and a red nose, three orders on his chest.

10658.d: Korrakaitsja vormis ja mütsiga mehe portree helesinise taeva ja vaatetorniga maastiku taustal. Pildi alla hariliku pliiatsiga kirjutatud kujutatava nimi kirillitsas: Petr Ivanovits Netsitailo.
10658.de: Portrait of a man in a police uniform and cap, against a background of light-blue sky and a landscape with a watchtower. Below the picture, written in pencil in Cyrillic, the name of the person depicted: Petr Ivanovich Nechitailo.

10659.d: Maastikuvaade raudtee, elektripostide ja pisikese hoonega, ümber puud ja põõsad.
10659.de: Landscape view with a railway, electric poles and a small building, surrounded by trees and bushes.

10660.d: Naerva heledapäise naise portree otsevaates kerge pöördega vasakule.
10660.de: Portrait of a laughing fair-haired woman in a frontal view with a slight turn to the left.

10661.d: Istuva noore naise poolfiguurportree, pilk pööratud alla vasakule, seljas roosa T-särk, millele kirjutatud „Hotsu Putina“, taustal mustriline tapeet.
10661.de: Half-length portrait of a young woman sitting, gaze turned down to the left, wearing a pink T-shirt inscribed "Hotsu Putina", against a patterned wallpaper background.

10662.d: Kolmveerandpöördes vanema mehe ja tema rinnale pea toetava otsevaates noorema naise portree. Mehel seljas tume ülikond, roheline pluus ja lips, naisel silmad tugevasti meigitud.
10662.de: A three-quarter turn portrait of an older man and, in frontal view, a younger woman resting her head on his chest. The man wears a dark suit, a green blouse and a tie, the woman's eyes are heavily made up.

10663.d: Seisva veerandpöördes vasakule naise portree, seljas sinine kostüüm ja valge pluus, dekoltee rindadeni avatud.
10663.de: Portrait of a woman standing in a quarter-turn to the left, wearing a blue costume and a white blouse, the décolletage open to the breasts.

10664.d: Punaste ringidega kollases kleidis ja peapaelas naise veerandpöördes paremale portree, käed tõstetud žestiks, näoilme midagi seletav.
10664.de: Portrait in three-quarter turn to the right of a woman in a yellow dress with red circles and a headband, hands raised in a gesture, facial expression explaining something.

10665.d: : Valges karvamütsis ja kasukas punaste põskede ja ninaga naise portree, taust üleni valge.
10665.de: : Portrait of a woman in a white fur hat and fur coat with red cheeks and nose, background entirely white.

10666.d: Mustas korsetis ja sukkades istuva ja end meikiva naise portree, taust üleni hall.
10666.de: Portrait of a woman sitting in a black corset and stockings, applying make-up, the background entirely grey.

10667.d: : Žestikuleeriva hallipäise mehe portree, seljas must pullover ja hall jakk, taustal puudega maastik.
10667.de: : Portrait of a gesticulating grey-haired man, wearing a black pullover and a grey jacket, landscape with trees in the background.

10668.d: Üles pööratud silmadega habemes ja kahe peene patsiga noorema mehe portree, seljas pruun riideese, taust üleni must.
10668.de: Portrait of a bearded younger man with two thin braids, eyes turned upward, wearing a brown garment, background entirely black.

10669.d: Naise veerandpöördes paremale portree, seljas peente paeltega must pluus, rinnale asetatud kolm paari kääre.
10669.de: Portrait of a woman in a three-quarter turn to the right, wearing a black blouse with thin ribbons, three pairs of scissors placed on her chest.

10670.d: : Valges karatekostüümis ja musta vööga mehe kolmveerandfiguurportree, käed tõstetud võidužestiks, suu hüüatuseks avatud.
10670.de: : Three-quarter figure portrait of a man in a white karate costume with a black belt, hands raised in a victory gesture, mouth open in a shout.

10671.d: Stseen paberkotti süütava punases üleriides mehega puudega maastiku taustal.
10671.de: A scene with a man in a red overcoat lighting a paper bag, against a landscape with trees.

10672.d: Mustajuukselise, paljastatud rindadega naise portree veerandpöördes paremale.
10672.de: Portrait of a dark-haired woman with exposed breasts, in a three-quarter turn to the right.

10673.d: : Veriste lõugade ja rinnaesisega seisva tiigri poolfiguurportree, taust üleni must.
10673.de: : Half-figure portrait of a standing tiger with bloody jaws and chest, the background entirely black.

10674.d: Seisva hunditopise poolfiguurportree, taust üleni must.
10674.de: Half-length portrait of a standing stuffed wolf, background entirely black.

10675.d: Kahe palja ülakeha ja tõstetud kätega naise portree metsa taustal.
10675.de: Portrait of two women with bare upper bodies and raised arms, against a forest background.

10676.d: Akordion süles istuva heledapäise naise portree, taustaks loodusvaade.
10676.de: Portrait of a fair-haired woman sitting with an accordion in her lap, with a landscape view in the background.

10677.d: Kiilaspäise ülikonnas mehe portree, rinnas Vene lipuga märk ja kollase tähega punaorden.
10677.de: Portrait of a bald man in a suit, with a badge bearing the Russian flag on his chest and a red order with a yellow star.

10678.d: Vaade põleva lageda maastikuga, esiplaan kõrbevärvi must, silmapiir leekides oranž.
10678.de: View of a burning open landscape, foreground scorched black, horizon orange with flames.

10679.d: Prille käes hoidva valges pluusis ja mustas seelikus naise portree, dekoltee rindadeni avatud.
10679.de: Portrait of a woman in a white blouse and black skirt holding glasses, décolleté open to the breasts.

10680.d: Valges kitlis laialt naeratava tumedapäise naise portree veerandpöördes paremale.
10680.de: Portrait of a dark-haired woman in a white smock, smiling broadly, in a quarter turn to the right.

10681.d: : Stseen kolme tantsiva rahvarõivas naisega, seljas valged pluusid ja punase-kollasemustrilised pihikseelikud ning peas punased ja kollased rätikud.
10681.de: : Scene with three dancing women in folk costume, wearing white blouses and red-yellow-patterned bodice-skirts, with red and yellow headscarves.

10682.d: Hallides toonides, pea ja põlvede juurest ära lõigatud musklilise mehekeha kujutis, taust üleni must.
10682.de: In grey tones, depiction of a muscular male body cropped at the head and knees, background entirely black.

10683.d: Hallides toonides potisoengu ja avatud suuga mehe portree.
10683.de: Portrait in grey tones of a man with a bowl haircut and open mouth.

10684.d: Kujutis rituaalsete näomaalingutega alasti naise ja kera hoidva savifiguuriga, taust must.
10684.de: Depiction of a naked woman with ritual face paintings and a clay figure holding a sphere, background black.

10685.d: : Lauavaade ajalehe, suitsukonidega tuhatoosi, kollase numbriga sildi ja avatud tikutopsiga, mille peal Edgar Savisaare pilt.
10685.de: : A table view with a newspaper, an ashtray with cigarette butts, a sign with a yellow number, and an open matchbox, on top of which a picture of Edgar Savisaar.

10697.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
10697.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakust äärest kulgevad must-valged triipud, neile lisanduvad keskosas eri variatsioonides hallid toonid ning paremalt lõpeb musta ja tumehalliga.
10697.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped barcode, with black-and-white stripes running from its left edge, joined in the middle section by grey tones in various variations, and ending on the right with black and dark grey.

10698.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
10698.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakul musta ja eri tooni lillaga antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged, lõppedes mustvalgena.
10698.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code band, on the left of which the stripes given in black and various shades of purple are joined by white ones, ending in black and white.

10699.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
10699.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat mille must-valgele osale lisanduvad keskosas eri toonides kollased ja oranžid triibud. Paremal lõpeb must-valgena.
10699.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, to whose black-and-white section yellow and orange stripes of various shades are added in the middle section. Ends in black-and-white on the right.

10700.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
10700.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel vasakul valge ja eri tooni sinisega antud triipudesse lisanduvad keskosas mustad, muutudes ositi mustvalgeks ning keskel ja paremal taas musta- ja punasetriibuliseks.
10700.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, on which on the left white and blue of various tones stripes are joined in the middle section by black ones, partly turning black-and-white, and in the centre and on the right becoming black-and-red striped again.

10701.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
10701.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel must-valged triibud vaheldumas mustale pinnale maalitud eri variatsioonides antud roheliste triipudega.
10701.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code band, with black-and-white stripes alternating on a black surface painted with green stripes given in various variations.

10702.dm: sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm; kõrgus: 11.0 cm
10702.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, mille vasakul musta ja eri tooni punasega antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged, muutudes keskosas mustvalgeks ning paremal taas musta- ja punasetriibuliseks.
10702.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped barcode, in which on the left, black and various shades of red stripes are joined by white ones, turning into black-and-white in the middle section, and again into black-and-red striped on the right.

10703.dm: kõrgus: 11.0 cm; sügavus: 2.5 cm; laius: 183.0 cm
10703.d: Kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutav plaat, millel vasakul musta ja tumepruuniga antud triipudesse lisanduvad valged. Keskel ja paremal musta ja valge vahel eri toonides pruunid triibud. Paremal lõpeb värvipind musta- ja pruunitriibulisena.
10703.de: A plate depicting a narrow striped code strip, on which, on the left, white stripes are added to the black and dark brown stripes given. In the middle and on the right, between black and white, brown stripes of various tones. On the right the coloured surface ends in black and brown stripes.

10712.dm: kõrgus: 200.0 cm; laius: 110.0 cm; kõrgus: 170.0 cm; laius: 142.0 cm
10712.d: Kahest osast koosnev, must-valgetes toonides antud, pead käte vahele toetuva vana naise portree. Pildipinnal valgeid abstraktseid, teineteist läbistavaid jooni.
10712.de: A two-part portrait, given in black-and-white tones, of an old woman resting her head between her hands. On the picture surface white abstract lines intersecting one another.

10723.d: Punakates ja rohekates toonides ekspressiivne kompositsioon voolavate värvijugadega. Vasakul tahapoole nõjatuv inimfiguur, paremal abstraktsest värvipinnast esile tulev inimnägu.
10723.de: An expressive composition in reddish and greenish tones with flowing streams of colour. On the left a human figure leaning backward, on the right a human face emerging from an abstract field of colour.

10724.d: Tumedates rohekates ja punakates toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes heledatest värviniredest moodustuvad kaks figuuri. Taevast markeeriv osa tumeroheline, maad markeeriv osa tumepunane, all vasakus nurgas linnupesa kolme munaga.
10724.de: A semi-abstract composition in dark greenish and reddish tones, in the center of which two figures are formed from light streaks of color. The part marking the sky is dark green, the part marking the earth is dark red, in the lower left corner a bird's nest with three eggs.

10725.d: Punakates, rohekates ja roosades toonides poolabstraktne kompositsioon, mille keskmes ettepoole kallutatud inimfiguure meenutavad värvipinnad. Taevast markeeriv osa punakates-roosakates ning maad markeeriv osa sinakates-rohekates toonides, maalilaad kohati pastoosne, kohati laseeriv.
10725.de: A semi-abstract composition in reddish, greenish and pink tones, at the centre of which are colour surfaces reminiscent of human figures leaning forward. The part marking the sky is in reddish-pinkish tones and the part marking the earth in bluish-greenish tones, the painting technique is at times pastose, at times glazed.

10812.d: Kompositsiooni keskmeks on end konksu tõmmanud
10812.de: The centre of the composition is a figure that has curled itself into a hook.

10813.d: Teose keskseks motiiviks on abstraktsed kaks labajalga ja käsi. Maalitud tumehallides, mustades ja punastes toonides hoogsate pintsilöökidega.
10813.de: The central motif of the work is two abstract feet and a hand. Painted in dark grey, black and red tones with vigorous brushstrokes.

10814.d: Kompositsiooni keskseks motiiviks on kägarasse positsiooni tõmbunud abstrakne figuur tumehallides toonides. Taust helehall, paremal alumises servas verepritsmeid meenutavad jäljed.
10814.de: The central motif of the composition is an abstract figure drawn into a curled-up position, in dark grey tones. The background light grey, in the lower right corner marks resembling blood splatters.

10886.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallika figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuuri pea on langetatud ja käed rüppes.
10886.de: The upper part of a greyish figure depicted against a background with a light blue gradation. The figure's head is lowered and hands rest in the lap.

10887.d: Sinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallikates-sinakates toonides figuuri ülemist kehaosa. Figuur toetab oma küünernukke justkui lauale, hoides käes valget pliiatsit.
10887.de: Against a background with blue gradation, the upper part of a figure's body is depicted in greyish-bluish tones. The figure rests its elbows as if on a table, holding a white pencil in its hand.

10888.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal žestikuleerib hallikas figuur kätega: vasaku käe laba on pööratud taeva poole, parema käe pöial ja nimetissirm justkui hoiaksid midagi väikest.
10888.de: Against a background with a pale blue gradation, a grayish figure gestures with its hands: the palm of the left hand is turned towards the sky, the thumb and index finger of the right hand as if holding something small.

10889.d: Helesinise gradatsiooniga taustal kujutatud hallika figuuri ülemine kehaosa. Figuur hoiab paremat kätt pea juures, hoides püsti nimetissõrme.

10890.d: Taevalaotuses hõljub kiilakas naisakt punaste kontsakingadega ja veiniklaasiga. Tema kohal avaneb punakas taevavõlv inglitega. Akti vaatlevad maali mõlemas servas seisvad tõbised figuurid roosa rüüga, kelle vahel suitsevad tööstushoonete torud. Maali alumises servas kujutatud punakates ja purpur toonides figuure joomas ja suitsetamas.
10890.de: In the vault of the sky a bald female nude hovers, wearing red high-heeled shoes and holding a wine glass. Above her a reddish heavenly vault opens with angels. The nude is observed by sickly figures in pink robes standing at both edges of the painting, between whom smoking industrial building chimneys appear. In the lower edge of the painting, figures in reddish and purple tones are depicted drinking and smoking.

10891.d: Ookri taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Mööda kujutatu nägu sibavad kärbseid meenutavad putukad.
10891.de: Bust portrait of a figure in profile to the left against an ochre background. Insects resembling flies crawl over the face of the subject.

10892.d: Tumerohelisel taustal figuuri rindportree profiilis vasakule. Kiilaka portreteeritu nahk on kaetud rõugeid meenutava naha deformatsiooniga.
10892.de: On a dark green background, a bust portrait of a figure in profile facing left. The skin of the bald sitter is covered with a pox-like skin deformation.

10896.d: Vasakust servast ülemisse paremasse serva kulgeb rida sarnaste peadega. Kujutatud isikute silmad on sinakad-hallid ja pead kiilakad- nähtaval on vaid pool nägu.
10896.de: From the left edge to the upper right edge runs a row of similar heads. The eyes of the depicted persons are bluish-grey and the heads bald – only half of the face is visible.

10898.d: Valgel taustal kujutatud tosin figuure rindportrees vasakule. Figuuridel seljas õhulised valged rüüd, mis justkui kulgevad valgetest pudelitest välja. Ühel figuuril jookseb mööda põske pisar.
10898.de: Against a white background, a dozen figures depicted in bust portrait facing left. The figures wear airy white robes that seem to emerge out of white bottles. On one figure a tear runs down the cheek.

10917.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
10917.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

10918.d: Kolm järjestikku asetsevat kitsast triibulist koodiriba kujutavat plaati; vasakpoolne ots puna-musta-oranži triibuline läheb üle monokroomseks must-valgeks ja paremalt lõpeb sügavsinise-mustaga.
10918.de: Three narrow striped bar-code-like plates arranged in a row; the left end, striped in red-black-orange, transitions into monochrome black and white, and ends on the right in deep blue-black.

11131.dm: kogus: 29.0 tk (figuriinide arv); kõrgus: 21.5 cm (figuriinid); laius: 9.5 cm (figuriinid); sügavus: 80.0 cm (kuppel)
11131.d: Koosneb 29 figuriinist (28 kipsist + 1 steariinist), värvitud spreivärviga (autode kruntvärv, tumehall), osad kaetud PVA liimiga, osadel kostüümi detailid värvitud akrüüliga, 1 kaetud naturaalse kollase villaga) + 1 valgest steariinist figuriin. Figuriinide kõrgus 21,5 cm; laius 9,5 cm, sügavus 7 cm. Figuriinid on asetatud bordoopunase sünteetilise plüüškangaga kaetud alusele. Alus figuriinidega on kaetud pleksiklaasist kupliga mõõdus 80x80 x h 70 cm. Kogu kompositsiooni ümbritseb neljast messingtooni metallpostist ja neljast punase plüüshiga kaetud piirdetrossist moodustatud piire. Figuuride  ümber on seotud punane siidpael.
11131.de: Consists of 29 figurines (28 plaster + 1 stearin), painted with spray paint (car primer paint, dark grey), some covered with PVA glue, on some the costume details are painted with acrylic, 1 covered with natural yellow wool) + 1 figurine of white stearin. Height of figurines 21.5 cm; width 9.5 cm, depth 7 cm. The figurines are placed on a base covered with burgundy-red synthetic plush fabric. The base with the figurines is covered with a plexiglass dome measuring 80x80 x h 70 cm. The entire composition is surrounded by a barrier formed of four brass-toned metal posts and four barrier ropes covered with red plush. A red silk ribbon is tied around the figures.

11273.d: Vitriinimannekeen (meesmannekeen), T-särk, püksid, käes kandevõrk, milles rull WC paberit ja pool põrandaleiba (leib lisada iga kord eksponeerimisel), jalas tennised, jalge all kunstmuru, mis ümbritsetud pesulõksudest taraga, murul plastikust kunstlilled; figuuri taga linoleumplaat taustmaalinguga: helesinine taevas valgete pilvekestega ning tekst: Its so easy to be an artist
11273.de: Shop window mannequin (male mannequin), T-shirt, trousers, holding a net bag containing a roll of toilet paper and half a loaf of floor bread (bread to be added each time the work is exhibited), sneakers on the feet, artificial grass underfoot surrounded by a fence of clothes pegs, plastic artificial flowers on the grass; behind the figure a linoleum board with a background painting: light blue sky with small white clouds and text: Its so easy to be an artist

12245.de: An installation in a viewing box surrounded by 30 electric lamps, lined with purple velvet. The viewing box stands on a wooden frame with legs. In the box, reclining against pillows, is a figure with a pig's body and legs and a face tuned to resemble a woman's. It has greenish glass eyes, and the pig's snout is shaped into a woman's mouth and nostrils. The figure has woman's hands with acrylic nails. The Pig-Woman, with woman's hands, reclines against pillows in a boudoir-like viewing box and watches on a colour television the film "Yoko" about the mining of precious stones (National Geographic. Amazing Rocks). In the background, Marilyn Monroe's song "Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend" plays. The colour television is set in a special window built into the side wall of the box. An elongated face with harmonious features, smiling lips, a shorter straight nose, the eyes indicated, the upper eyelid worked out, rich curly hair partly gathered at the nape, hair falling in curls onto the neck, individual curls indicated on the forehead.

12564.dm: aeg/ kestus: 5.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 4.0 minut
12564.d: Kirvemees ajab mööda korterit taga tõenäoliselt tema enda naist ja kahte last. Naine ja lapsed proovivad ennast igale poole ära peita -  küll diivani või voodi taha või kapi taha või teki alla, aga kirvemees leiab nad alati üles ja siis juhtub midagi. Ja iga kord peale seda midagi on kirvemees ikka rohkem ja rohkem verega koos. Naine ja kaks last aga näevad järjest paremad välja. Ja nii muudkui lõputult. (Marko Mäetamm)
12564.de: An axe-man is chasing through the apartment, probably his own wife and two children. The woman and children try to hide themselves everywhere - behind the sofa or bed, or behind the cupboard, or under the blanket, but the axe-man always finds them and then something happens. And each time after that something, the axe-man is more and more covered in blood. But the woman and the two children look better and better. And so it goes on endlessly. (Marko Mäetamm)

12576.d: Videos vaade aknast välja, väljas paistavad tuule käes liikuvad puuoksad. Kulunud vanaaegses köites, marliga kinni seotud raamat, esiküljel marlipaelade ristumiskohal vatipadjake. Raamatul "peas" luitunud valge beebimüts. Raamat asetseb videoekraani ees keskel.
12576.de: In the video, a view out of a window, outside branches of a tree moving in the wind can be seen. A worn book in an antique binding, tied with gauze, with a cotton pad at the crossing point of the gauze ribbons on the front cover. On "top" of the book a faded white baby's bonnet. The book is placed in the middle in front of the video screen.

12577.dm: aeg/ kestus: 17.0 minut; aeg/ kestus: 18.0 sekund
12577.d: Esiplaanil paremal valgete linade vahel külili lamava naise (E.-L. Semper) ülakeha. Naise kätes näo juures väike elus hiir. Taustal jooksevad panoraamid suvistest maastikest.
12577.de: In the foreground, on the right, the upper body of a woman (E.-L. Semper) lying on her side amid white sheets. In the woman's hands, near her face, a small live mouse. In the background, panoramas of summer landscapes running past.

12579.d: Ülal keskel tekst "All Things Electric". Vahelduvad kaks tehismaastikku kujutavat motiivi ja kaks inglisekeelset tekstiplokki. Ülemisel pildil mees mustas ülikonnas, käes kohver ja kepp. Taevas planeeditaoline objekt. Mehe rinda ja objekti ühendab valge looklev joon. All vasakul draakoni  kujutis. Alumisel pildil tehismaastik, millest tõusevad kaks koonuse kujulist ja üks silinderjas moodustis. Neid ümbritseb puudesalu.  All paremal kõndiv inimfiguur.
12579.de: At the top centre, the text "All Things Electric". Two motifs depicting artificial landscapes alternate with two blocks of English text. In the upper image, a man in a black suit, holding a suitcase and a cane. In the sky, a planet-like object. A white winding line connects the man's chest to the object. At the bottom left, a depiction of a dragon. In the lower image, an artificial landscape from which two cone-shaped and one cylindrical formation rise. They are surrounded by a grove of trees. At the bottom right, a walking human figure.

12583.d: Ülal paremal valgel taustal kolm musta kaarjat joont. Kaarte kontuurid hajutatud. All paremal kaks musta puhmjat kujutist. All vasakul mustade trükitähtedega BLAST

12588.dm: aeg/ kestus: 4.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 30.0 minut
12588.d: Interaktiivne video- ja heliinstallatsioon. Videoprojektsioon seinal, mille ees seisab mikrofon. Vaataja peab teose aktiveerimiseks mikrofoni laulma või muul moel häält tegema. Ekraanil liibuvas erksavärvilises spordirõivastuses  naine (Mare Tralla), kes reageerides vaataja häälele hakkab erineval moel laulma, liigutama ja hüppama. Taustaks Tallinna Lauluväljaku lava.
12588.de: An interactive video and sound installation. A video projection on the wall, in front of which stands a microphone. To activate the work, the viewer must sing or otherwise make a sound into the microphone. On the screen, a woman (Mare Tralla) in tight brightly coloured sportswear, who, reacting to the viewer's voice, begins to sing, move, and jump in various ways. In the background, the stage of the Tallinn Song Festival Grounds.

12611.d: Ülaosas mustal taustal korrapäraste valgete täppide read, mis järgjärgult hõrenedes muutuvad mustadeks täppideks valgel taustal. All keskel mustade trükitähtedega FALLOUT

Kleebised on mõeldud KUMU hoone klaasist sise- ja välisustele kleepimiseks. Autorite poolt on ära määratud, millised kleebised millistel ustel paiknevad. Videot eksponeerida vastavalt KUMU näitusteprogrammile.
12617.de: A site-specific installation consisting of 18 transparent stickers depicting various actions and icons as black symbols. The stickers are intended to be applied to the glass interior and exterior doors of the KUMU building. The authors have specified which stickers are to be placed on which doors. The video is to be displayed according to the KUMU exhibition programme.

12754.d: Performance Andrus Joonase kureeritud Pärnu kunsti ülevaatenäitusel Pärnu Uue Kunsti Muuseumis, kus Mari Kartau ilmub näitusesaali punases kleidis, riietub publiku ees lahti, viskab kleidi koos kaelast ja kõrvast võetud võtmetega näitusesaali krüpti ning kleidi alt ilmub nähtavale metalse võre ja tabalukkudega kokku köidetud voorusevöö. Kunstnik laskub ka ise valgustatud ja valge kangaga vooderdatud krüpti, mille põhjas on laiali pillutatuna punaseid roosiõisi ja võtmed, kinnitab end rihmade abil põrandakonstruktsiooni külge ning hakkab kääridega aeglaselt, kiud-kiu haaval läbi lõikama teda hoidvat kinnitusköit. Protsess kestab seni, kuni köis katkeb ja kunstnik selili krüpti põhja valgele k
12754.de: A performance at the survey exhibition of Pärnu art curated by Andrus Joonas at the Pärnu New Art Museum, where Mari Kartau appears in the exhibition hall in a red dress, undresses in front of the audience, throws the dress together with keys taken from around her neck and ear into the crypt of the exhibition hall, and beneath the dress a chastity belt bound together with a metal grid and padlocks becomes visible. The artist herself also descends into the illuminated crypt lined with white cloth, at the bottom of which red rose blossoms and keys are scattered, fastens herself to the floor construction with straps, and begins slowly, fibre by fibre, to cut through the rope holding her with scissors. The process continues until the rope breaks and the artist falls on her back onto the white [cloth] at the bottom of the crypt

12755.dm: aeg/ kestus: 50.0 sekund; aeg/ kestus: 10.0 minut
12755.d: Installatsioon ja performance Tanel Saare isikunäitusel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis, kus grupp alasti gaasimaskides kunstnikke imiteerivad häälitsuse saatel terade nokkimist näitusesaali põrandalt. Ühel hetkel hakatakse kunstnikke publiku seast pilduma toorete munadega, mispeale kunstnikud ükshaaval näitusesaalist lahkuvad. Seejärel heidab üks kunstnikest põrandale pikali, teised aga hakkavad seinalt sinna ühtlase kihina kinnitatud kanajalgasid korjama ja neid lamavale kunstnikule peale heitma, kuni viimane üleni kanajalgadega kattub. Performance toimus Tanel Saare ärakeelatud isikunäituse avamisel ja lõpetamisel Haapsalu Linnagaleriis 28. märtsil 2001. aastal. Näitus koosnes 5000 näitusesaali se
12755.de: An installation and performance at Tanel Saar's solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii, where a group of naked artists in gas masks imitate the pecking of grain from the floor of the exhibition hall accompanied by vocalisations. At one point the artists are pelted with raw eggs from among the audience, whereupon the artists leave the exhibition hall one by one. Then one of the artists lies down flat on the floor, while the others begin to collect chicken feet attached in an even layer to the wall and throw them onto the artist lying down, until the latter is completely covered with chicken feet. The performance took place at the opening and closing of Tanel Saar's banned solo exhibition at the Haapsalu Linnagalerii on 28 March 2001. The exhibition consisted of 5000 chicken feet attached to the exhibition hall wall

12763.d: Videoinstallatsioon 6 monitorile. "Kirjuta stsenaarium filmile, mis leiab aset sinu enda kodus ning kus üks osatäitjatest on noor soome naine!" Jagades sellist kuulutust teadetetahvlitel ja tänavaplankudel otsis Soome kunstnik Tellervo Kalleinen inimestega kontakti kuues erinevas maailma linnas (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Peterburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Aastatel 2001-2003 külastas kunstnik ca. 65 kodu, et näidelda stseenariumite järgi, mida inimesed olid projekti tarbeks välja pakkunud.(eesti)
12763.de: Video installation for 6 monitors. "Write a scenario for a film that takes place in your own home and in which one of the performers is a young Finnish woman!" By distributing such an advertisement on notice boards and street hoardings, the Finnish artist Tellervo Kalleinen sought contact with people in six different cities around the world (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Petersburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur). Between 2001 and 2003, the artist visited approx. 65 homes in order to act out the scenarios that people had proposed for the project.

12808.d: „Igavene tuli“ on lavastatud dokumentaalfilm armastusest propageeritud eeskujude vastu. Nõukogude vaimus üles kasvatatud tütarlaps õpetatakse lugu pidama kangelastest, kelle meeldetuletusi pronksskulptuuridena oli täis kogu meie linn. Neiu usk ideaalsesse aga leiab väljenduse armastuses pühakuju vastu. Selleks on nõukoguliku ateistliku riigikorra ajal kasvanud tütarlapsele Tõnismäe Pronkssõdur. Sõdur aga ei suuda välja kanda Igavese Armastuse kehastamist...
12808.de: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...

Jagades sellist kuulutust teadetetahvlitel ja tänavaplankudel otsis Soome kunstnik Tellervo Kalleinen inimestega kontakti kuues erinevas maailma linnas (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Peterburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seydisfjördur).  Aastatel 2001-2003 külastas kunstnik ca. 65 kodu, et näidelda stseenariumite järgi, mida inimesed olid projekti tarbeks välja pakkunud.
12880.de: Video installation for 6 monitors. "Write a screenplay for a film that takes place in your own home and in which one of the actors is a young Finnish woman!" By distributing such an announcement on notice boards and street billboards, Finnish artist Tellervo Kalleinen sought contact with people in six different cities around the world (Helsinki, Tallinn, St. Petersburg, Los Angeles, Hamburg, Seyðisfjörður). Between 2001 and 2003 the artist visited approximately 65 homes in order to act out, according to the scenarios that people had proposed for the project.

12967.d: „Igavene tuli“ on lavastatud dokumentaalfilm armastusest propageeritud eeskujude vastu. Nõukogude vaimus üles kasvatatud tütarlaps õpetatakse lugu pidama kangelastest, kelle meeldetuletusi pronksskulptuuridena oli täis kogu meie linn. Neiu usk ideaalsesse aga leiab väljenduse armastuses pühakuju vastu. Selleks on nõukoguliku ateistliku riigikorra ajal kasvanud tütarlapsele Tõnismäe Pronkssõdur. Sõdur aga ei suuda välja kanda Igavese Armastuse kehastamist...
12967.de: "Eternal Fire" is a staged documentary film about love for propagated role models. A girl raised in the Soviet spirit is taught to respect heroes, reminders of whom in the form of bronze sculptures filled our whole town. But the girl's faith in the ideal finds expression in love for a sacred image. For a girl who grew up in the era of the Soviet atheist state order, this is the Bronze Soldier of Tõnismägi. But the soldier is unable to bear the embodiment of Eternal Love...

13157.de: A red cuboid-shaped house with a flat roof, at each of the four corners golden carvings on top of a pole (a hand, the end of a ruler's staff, etc.). Attached to the house is a section of fence painted with white flags.

13183.d: Kõrvuti istuvad indiaanipäraste näojoontega naine ja tema vasaku õla taga naisega samas mõõdus kikkis kõrvadega must sileda karvaga loom. Pilk mõlemal vaataja poole. Naisel seljas lilla valgete ääristega kampsun, käed süles, põlvedel triibuline vaip. Keskel suurte valgete tähtedega: Ellinor Crimson. All väiksemalt: They like nuts for better for worse. 13183.de: Side by side sit a woman with Native American facial features and, behind her left shoulder, an animal of the same size as the woman, with pricked-up ears and black smooth fur. Both gazes are directed at the viewer. The woman is wearing a purple sweater with white trim, her hands in her lap, a striped blanket on her knees. In the centre in large white letters: Ellinor Crimson. Below, smaller: They like nuts for better for worse. Below that: A Trinidad & Tobago Film. At the very bottom in yellow lettering: Carbonary Pictures Presents. In the lower right corner a logo and text: While Away Films

13184.d: Foto ümarast tornist, millel on suurte punaste tähtedega kirillitsas kiri "Mai". Pildi alumist osa katab punalipp, selle taustal paistab tumeda peaga tüdruk peas punane kapuuts. 13184.de: A photo of a round tower bearing an inscription in Cyrillic in large red letters reading "Mai". 13186.d: Must-valge foto lina all lebavast naisest, paistab ainult tumedate juustega pea suures plaanis, pilk pööratud vasakule. Ülal paremal aknaraami nurk, vasakult sirutub naise pea kohale käe vari. Keskel suur must kiri: Thilda Thumb II. Selle all valgega: Enriko Palazzi Ernst Flex. Esiplaanil valge karp punase kirjaga How to Host a Murder, sellel kirevad idamaised kujukesed ja kaks halli silindrikujulist kinnist anumat. Ülal vasakul väike valge kiri: dead men tell no tales. 46331.d: „Homo EKAdemicus“ käsitleb Linnap irooniliselt Eesti Kunsti ja Arhitektuuri Biograafilise Leksikonist suurendatud piltide kaudu fotoretuši nõukogulike maneeride üllatavat jätkumist praegusel (!) ajastul. See osundab kronoloogilise aja ja mentaliteedi muutuste kulgemist erineva kiirusega. Olukord on paradoksaalne – repressiivse ajastu portreelise retuši kalk maneer muudab de facto muidu leebed-lüürilised kunstnikud ja kunstiajaloolased piltidel lausa stalinlikeks robotiteks. Briti Arnolfini galerii publik pidas portreteerituid näiteks surnud põlvkondade esindajaiks

65316.d:
Maara Vindi (s. 1955) looming on paljuski kujunenud oma kunstnikest vendade Tõnis ja Toomas Vindi ning vennanaiste Mare ja Aili Vindi mõjusfääris. Tema pildimaailm on äratuntavalt isikupärane. 
Selgelt loetavad, lineaarsed joonistused väljendavad esteetilist ja elitaarset suhtumist ümbritsevasse. Maara Vindi joonistused on hermeetilised, tulvil mitmesuguseid sümboleid ja mütoloogilisi motiive loodusest, kristlikust religioonist, vabamüürlusest jne.

65359.dm: lehe laius: 65.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 50.0 cm
65359.d: Reti Saks (s. 1960) lõpetas ERKI 1987, ta töötab tänaseni peamiselt graafikuna, olles rahvusvaheliselt aktiivne ja saanud mitmeid tunnustusi. Kunstnik loob ka skulptuure ja raamatuillustratsioone. Reti Saksa kunstisõnumit vahendab üksik (või mitu) lapselike proportsioonidega sootu figuur mustvalges tühjas pildiruumis. Minimalistlike vahenditega annab graafik edasi ängistavaid, sageli krüptilisi meeleseisundeid. Paarik „Segadus segaduses“ (2009) näitab originaaljoonistust ja estampgravüüri kui graafiku tööprotsessi astmeid ja erinevaid kunstimeediumeid.

78929.d: The Estonian Pavilion at the 49th Venice biennial was a collaboration between artists Ene-Liis Semper and Marko Laimre at La Fondazione Ugo e Olga Levi, Palazzo Giustinian Lolini. Ene-Liis Semper and Marko Laimre came to art more or less at the same time, somewhere in the mid-1990s. The first as a dangerous heroine of ritual performances and with body-focused videos; the other with actions laced by meta-art strategies and installations with an anarcho-political flavour. The work of both Laimre and Semper seems to indicate that a fundamental error, a complication, or at least a disharmony has been written into the elaborate mechanism of the present existence; and they are trying to capture it. Both have used their own selves and body as material, and have moulded the data of their personal histories into art. This is still very important to them. As strong personalities, the two artists have touched the borders of society’s threshold of tolerance and pain, either unwittingly or on purpose. The critics have seen them as radicals, and this is what they certainly are – both consider the rules set by society as repressive. Their artistic handwriting, however, has a fairly different colo

78931.d: John Smith. Marko und Kaido. The Estonian Pavilion at the 50th Venice biennale John Smith (artist duo Kaido Ole and Marko Mäetamm) represented Estonia at the 50th Venice biennial with a show called “Marko und Kaido”, curated by Anders Härm at Palazzo Malipiero. Curator Anders Härm: “Yes, you are not mistaken – John Smith is the artist representing Estonia this year at the Venice biennial and the project is called “Marko und Kaido”. John Smith, of course, is a fictional character. He is the constantly changing Conceptual Persona of two artists, Marko Mäetamm and Kaido Ole, who have for years shared a studio. Under these circumstances – working side by side – the third guy John with a third point of view was born. We could recall here the statement of psychotherapist Felix Guattari: I and Deleuze never worked together, we were working somewhere in the space between us. Smith comes from the space between Ole and Mäetamm – he is the personified and schizo “uni-zone” as well as the working method of the artists. In contrast to, let’s say, Nietzsche´s Conceptual Persona Zarathustra, Smith is everything but the Übermensch. He is an … Idiot as if Deleuze´s and Guattari´s definition of this

78934.d: The Estonian Pavilion at the 51st Venice biennial presented a solo show by Mark Raidpere “Isolator” (curated by Hanno Soans). “In my opinion such Estonian ‘men and women’ are enemies of the Estonian state and should be isolated: let them operate within closed walls.” Märt Sults. A Duty to Preserve the Country, Postimees, 28 July 2004. „The first thing the Germans did was to forbid Jews access to swimming pools; it seemed to them that if the body of an Israelite were to plunge into that confined body of water, the water would be completely befouled.“ Jean-Paul Sartre. Anti-Semite and Jew, Temps Modernes, 1946 Curator Hanno Soans: The intimate exhibition rooms in Palazzo Malipiero where the Estonian display is located act as a conceptual apartment. Mark Raidpere’s solo exhibition examining his personal identity contradictions marks the co-ordinates of privacy in social space. The viewer, who for the first time encounters the abundant grotesque of the homo-erotic motives of Raidpere’s earlier pictures of himself, is taken by surprise. Whence this pain, strained to its limits, discretely brought to attention by the cigarette-burned stigmas on the hands in the black-and-white photograph

Curator Mika Hannula: “Marko Mäetamm has a confession to make. Or sorry, let me rephrase this: he has loads and loads of confessions to make. He wants to tell it all, just everything to us, and he wants us to listen to his worries and problems. Mäetamm is confused, he feels weak and almost completely inadequate when facing the demands and challenges of the contemporary world. He is afraid of failing, of losing his job, of not being able to pay his bank loan. He feels miserable without his wife and kids but feels equally unhappy when being with them. In other words, Mäetamm seems to be in a deep mess. But hold on, are these confessions as works of art true? Does he really mean it? Sure, of course they are both-and. These litanies of failures of coping with modern life are obviously and painstakingly as true as they are blue, but at the same time, they are also something else. 78947.d:
Be Drunk, Be Very, Very Drunk talks about the relationship between alcohol and philosophy. Based on Deleuze and Guattari, Anders Härm links becoming an (conceptual) idiot with alcohol, and later reaches Guy Debord considering Situationists International the first deliberately drunk revolution. The brandy consumed in the course of the lecture makes the academic presentation an ironic human experiment which tests the limits of acceptable and non-acceptable. The criticism does not fall only on the academical mannerism but also on the academy as an institution that is based on over-exploited concepts which smother creativity.

The documentation of the performance was born as an exchange with Latvian Television, who insisted a post-presentation interview from the lecturer before the performance. Härm agreed on the condition that the Latvian Television records the performance from the beginning. The recording reached the lecturer but the interview was dropped.

78950.d:
JIM is the common denominator of three artists – Johannes Säre, Iti Kasser and Maido Juss – officially registered by the state registry key 80283354. The artwork was initially created for the three artists’ solo exhibition in the Draakon Gallery and later took an iconic role in EKKM’s bar, where it was unfortunately destroyed in the course of active partying. By now, the piece has been restored. The

consists of the three artists’ portraits printed on glass and placed one behind the other to form a strange androgyne. This is a self portrait by JIM, the person – a mix of three artists to form a single being. This method is reflective of the group’s co-creating process, a symbiosis of world-views from three different artists.

78951.d: At first glance, it may seem that this is just a stage, but actually…it is not a stage. It is a sculpture. The work was completed by EKKM board member and artist Neeme Külm in the course of the TDK exhibition that took place at EKKM in 2009. It vividly demonstrates how funds for art projects can be transformed into something much more practical, which is needed at the time. Since the completion of the work of art is an adventure worthy of Ostap Bender and the symbolic exchange in the form of its miraculous transformation was an element in the structure of the work from the start, it is of course one of EKKM’s principal assets.

78959.d:
Laura Kuuse’s photo-series “Knife” was first exhibited at “Hullumeelsus”, an exhibition held in EKKM in 2008. “Knife” consists of two movie-like shots that draw attention to the structure of conversation. A story is automatically put together from the two photos, but many vastly different interpretations for the narrative are left possible.

The work was acquired in 2011 on the condition that the artist receives an invitation to an exhibition in 2013. Due to this agreement, the 2013 exhibiton “Kõrvalnähud / Side Effects” was curated by Laura Kuusk and Pascale Riou.

The work was completed for the 2004 Tallinn Print Triennial curator exhibition titled Other Neighborhood, in the course of which Hanno Soans smuggled the works of amateur artist Kortšagin in to the established exhibition space of Kunsthalle Tallinn.

Juri Kortšagin was born in Komsomolski and since 1962 has been living in Estonia. Kortšagin is a former soviet ‘leading worker’, who is retired today and works as a security guard and an amateur painter, who discovered a burning passion for painting at a later age.

Alver Linnamägi’s Letters from the Army was made during his service in the Estonian Defence Forces. At the same time Anneli Porri cureted an exhibition in EKKM titled Making of Contemporary Art. During the exhibition the museum received a letter each week for four consecutive weeks, for which there was a mailbox installed on a fence in front of the museum. There was none before and no mail had until then arrived to the museums address. Letters from the Army was from its beginning closely related to the EKKM and therefore it seemed logical to add the work to the collection. For its compensation, Anders Härm, a member of the museum’s board, replied to Alver Linnamägi’s letters while the originals were exhibited in EKKM in 2011 during the exhibition of the collection entitled Museum Files I: Collected Principles. The four replies also arrived to the museum’s address.

There was none before and no mail had until then arrived to the museums address. Letters from the Army was from its beginning closely related to the EKKM and therefore it seemed logical to add the work to the collection. For its compensation, Anders Härm, a member of the museum’s board, replied to Alver Linnamägi’s letters while the originals were exhibited in EKKM in 2011 during the exhibition of the collection entitled Museum Files I: Collected Principles. The four replies also arrived to the museum’s address.

Alver Linnamägi: ‘The four letters that were delivered from the Defence Forces to the EKKM were one of the few chances I, as a student and as a recruit, had to maintain a connection with the art world and the people in it. The work consists of texts written during night watch, descriptions of certain situations, which purpose was to share what was happening around me with people, to most of whom this environment seemed as alien as to myself. 78967.d:
The series of paintings named Tip of the Day was first exhibited in the Tallinn Art Hall exhibition Violence & Propaganda in 2006. The series consists of nine paintings, the texts of which were based on what was being said in the media.  Its core lies in the Guantanamo (Gitmo) prison camp, which was not subject to the Geneva Convention (III) concerning the rights and general human rights of ‘prisoners of war’ before July 2006. Focusing on three key elements – a gun, Casio watches and olive green – which should serve as the terrorists’ ‘field-marks’. The author raises questions concerning the background and reasons of placing people in prison camps. The series of paintings has been acquired in return for everlasting free entrance to EKKM exhibitions, even though Elin Kard is a member of the board of EKKM  and all exhibitions at EKKM are free.

Elin Kard: ‘At that time I read a lot of different materials from the foreign press about the Guantanamo (Gitmo) prison camp which at that time still operated. In my recollection various people who ended up in Gitmo were asked when, where, and on what grounds they were arrested. The staff was asked what the so called ‘external features’ are, which help to recognize terrorists. The required elements or elements that could be misleading were: possession of a gun, the Casio F-91W wristwatch and the use of olive green in clothing’.

78973.d:
Superflex, the well-known Danish art group, participated in the KUMU opening exhibition titled Shift Scale in 2006 with its non-alcoholic vodka project. Non-alcoholic vodka tastes like vodka but does not contain alcohol. The work seems to comment on uniqueness being lost in globalization – the need to comply with the demands and requirements of international markets and a struggle for survival amongst existing products sets a certain framework, of which being outside of is not beneficial to the product. Non-alcoholic vodka is a good example of a product being outside of said framework.

Hanno Soans, the curator of contemporary art in KUMU at the time and one of the organizers of the exhibition, acquired one of the bottles at the exhibition and donated it to the EKKM collection on the condition that a member of the management board of EKKM, Marco Laimre gets a bottle of alcohol free beer at the NOKU club without paying for it. The deal is yet to be completed, as Laimre has not been able to avoid paying at the bar.

78977.d:
by the artist duo Johnson and Johnson (Indrek Köster and Taavi Talve) raises the question of racial and ethnic sensitivity in an inevitably globalising Estonian society. The work consists of two stylised sculptures with their skin colours reversed: one depicts the head of a man with African features, the other with Caucasian features. Although their socially stigmatised characteristics have been exchanged, the two figures are united by national symbolism, prompting the question of to what extent Estonian culture belongs exclusively to ethnic Estonians.

“Can someone dressed in traditional Mulgimaa folk costume withstand a Ukrainian or Russian choir performing at the Song Festival? Can an African person wear a cornflower in their buttonhole? Is a foreign worker allowed only to work, or is pissing among the junipers and celebrating at beer festivals a privilege reserved only for? Is Eesti Energia’s accumulated capital outflows to Jordan’s oil shale fields an Estonia’s Business? Soundcheck is a test signal from the stage to the auditorium. Whether the response from the audience is ‘tolerant’ silence, the shouting of neo-Nazis, or something else entirely, depends on the audience itself.”
